shortDescription: Business Leadership South Africa CEO Busi Mavuso said reforms are taking too long to translate into improvements on the ground, while companies continue to bear the cost of failing municipal services, according to Bloomberg.

title: Busi Mavuso Says Slow Reforms Are Delaying Investment Gains
